_comment: Pinned stories shown above the live Substack feed in #writing. Newest first. Use this for pieces published off the Hinge & Near Field feed (Medium, The Daily Whatever Show). Remove an entry when it's no longer timely; an empty list hides the block.

stories.title: You Have Died of Dysentery
stories.excerpt: Shigella is back, it’s an STI now, it shrugs off all five oral antibiotics, and the CDC tracks it under food poisoning.

stories.title: Trump Keeps Committing Treason Live On Camera
stories.excerpt: Three times in three days he invited Iran to hit Los Angeles and San Diego. Article III defines exactly one crime.

stories.title: Trump Called Two American Cities a “Small Price.” Hurricane Isaias Would Like a F@#king Word.
stories.excerpt: He offered up Los Angeles and San Diego as a “small price.” Four days later the Gulf is sending the invoice, twenty-six days before the midterms.

stories.title: Ottumwa, Iowa Invited Religious Freedom and Got Exactly What It Ordered
stories.excerpt: The council adopted a policy welcoming every belief and none. Then someone showed up with a different belief, and a pastor demanded the curse be reversed.
